annotations.purpose: Main command router: parse all client messages and dispatch to handlers
notes: Duplicate of TCP.bas - use TCP as canonical

~900 lines. Parses message prefix and routes to appropriate handler. Key prefixes: LOGIN/NLOGIN/ERASE (auth), M (move), LC/RC (clicks), ; (say), - (shout), : (emote), BTL (battle), QIT (quit), /commands (slash commands). Ghost state (status=1) converts speech to 'oooOO'. All /commands are UCase compared. Handles GM commands separately (checks WizCheck).

annotations.purpose: Route a message to recipients based on sndRoute constant
notes: Duplicate of TCP.bas - use TCP as canonical

Core networking function. Routes: ToIndex(0)=single user, ToAll(1)=everyone, ToMap(2)=all on map, ToPCArea(3)=nearby users, ToNone(4)=nobody, ToAllButIndex(5)=all except one, ToMapButIndex(6)=all on map except one, ToGM(7)=all online GMs. Appends ENDC delimiter. ToPCArea checks 13-tile X radius.
